instruction: Change the font color of all italicized text to blue while keeping the italic formatting

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all italic text to blue color. Verified: document has 21 italic runs at paragraphs 6, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 18, 19. Evaluator checks all italic runs have blue-ish color (fuzzy match for various blue shades) and returns proportional score.

scoring_breakdown.partial: Some italic text is blue (proportional score)

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies all italic runs in the document and checks their font color
Metric function properly uses python-docx to parse .docx structure and extract formatting
Blue color detection uses reasonable fuzzy matching heuristic (b > r and b > g and b > 100)
Proportional scoring correctly handles partial completion (some italic text blue, some not)
Postconfig appropriately saves document (Ctrl+S) before file getter fetches it
Data flow is correct: save → fetch → parse → verify color → return score
Edge case handled: returns 0.0 if no italic text exists
Expected parameter correctly unused (blue is implicit requirement, empty rules dict is appropriate)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Blue heuristic (b > r and b > g and b > 100) may miss very light blues (e.g., RGB(200,200,255) where b is not strictly greater) or very dark blues (e.g., RGB(0,0,80) where b < 100). Consider relaxing to: b > max(r,g) and b > 60, or b/max(r,g,1) > 1.3
Consider logging which italic runs are not blue for debugging purposes
Document assumes python-docx handles .docx format correctly; no fallback for corrupted files (minor issue)
